script_title: How an Entailment Guard Reverts an Unsupported LLM Claim
concept: How an entailment guard reverts an unsupported LLM claim: token grounding sees words that exist somewhere in the corpus, but cannot see which employer a claim belongs to. Entailment asks whether the claim is supported by that bullet's own evidence.
